title: Redrawing Pak: Ministers back 12-province plan but pol, constitutional hurdles remain
summary_full: Pakistan is considering expanding its administrative framework by increasing its provinces from four to twelve, aiming for more efficient governance. Senior officials argue that smaller provinces could enhance public service delivery. Yet, this ambitious initiative faces political hurdles and requires unity among major parties. Redefining boundaries will necessitate constitutional amendments, and a potential referendum may follow, pending parliamentary consent.
